Building Overview Screen: This artifact is a system screen capture (Figure 4-3) from the OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual. It depicts the 'Building Overview' screen, which is accessed by pressing the OVERVIEW button from the main HMI.

System HMI Overview Screens: The four overview screens are: building overview, smalls overview, tilt-tray overview (not covered in this manual), and the ACB system overview. These screens tie into the existing customer system.

ACB System Overview Screen: This artifact is a system screen image showing the 'ACB System Overview' screen, as referenced in the OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual. Based on the surrounding text, this screen is part of the System HMI Screens section and is immediately followed by a legend (Figure 4-2) that explains its elements.

ACB System Overview Screen Legend: This artifact is the legend for the 'ACB System' overview screen, as referenced in section 4.1.1.1.2 of the OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual. It visually maps the color codes used to represent the status of different areas or components on the main system overview screen.

ACB System Statistics Screen: This artifact is a figure of the ACB System Statistics screen from the OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual. According to the nearby text, this screen is accessed by pressing the STATISTICS button on the 'ACB System' screen.

ACB API Screen: This artifact is a system screen capture of the ACB API interface, accessed by pressing the API button on the 'ACB System' screen. According to the manual, this screen provides controls for the OptiSweep system, AGVs, and totes, serving as a primary interface for operational commands.
ACB System Overview Screen Navigation: This screen displays the tilt-tray system layout and provides a color-coded status for each bin.

Smalls Overview Screen: The screen is accessed by pressing the SMALLS button on the HMI. It provides an at-a-glance operational health check of the smalls system through a color-coded status representation of each system part.

ACB System Statistics Metrics: These metrics are presented on the ACB System Statistics screen, which is part of the HMI. The specific units or calculation methods for these metrics are not detailed in this source.
ACB System Screen Navigation: This establishes a parent-child navigation relationship between the 'ACB System' screen and the 'ACB System Statistics' screen within the HMI.

Tilt Tray Overview Screen: According to the manual, pressing HMI CALCULATIONS on the ACB System screen accesses the Tilt Tray overview screen, indicating that the HMI Calculations screen serves as the primary overview for the Tilt Tray subsystem.

Belted ACB solution bag flow description: The OCR text states that in a belted ACB solution, when a destination is full the bin is dropped on a takeaway conveyor. The conveyor moves the packages as a slug down a chute into a bag station, where the user applies a label, zips the bag, and places it on a takeaway belt.

Right panel functions as an information area on the displayed screen: The presenter explicitly refers to the right panel as something that 'will give you some more information.' While the exact fields or metrics are not visible in this segment, the statement supports treating the panel as an informational UI component associated with the main screen.

System layout elements visible from the overview: OCR text states that the system layout shows Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS. It also notes that icons can be clicked for more information on Tippers, Hospitals, and GLDS. The source presents these as visible layout elements on the overview screen.
